# udoma_catalog_item_subscription (Resource)

Resource represents a catalog item subscription



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Code of the catalog item being subscribed to.

### Optional

- `patches` (Attributes List) Optional patches that override attributes of the subscribed catalog item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patches))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The date and time the subscription was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the catalog item subscription.
- `updated_at` (Number) The date and time the subscription was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--patches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patches`

Optional:

- `format` (String) Patch format (for example JSON patch or unified diff).
- `patch` (String) Patch payload.
- `patch_ref` (String) Reference key identifying a patch target.
